summary: Materialise NV, a Belgian 3D printing software and services firm, filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing the restart of its share buyback program effective August 31, 2026, after a closed period ended and the authorization was renewed. The program has no set amount, price, or duration; repurchases depend on market conditions and legal requirements, and the company may suspend or modify it. Weekly transaction reports will be published on its website. What to watch: pace of repurchases and any overhang reduction.
